name: Romero Multari
description: Romero Multari is a lanky Turami man in his early 30s with mahogany skin and dark hair and eyes. He lives with his family in Trollskull Alley and teaches languages and writing at Murkledorn's Academy.
ideals: Knowledge: 'Words and languages are the true bridges between diverse cultures and peaceful coexistence.'
bonds: His family living in Trollskull Alley.
flaws: Quiet and studious, sometimes missing intense social cues happening outside his academic focus.
speech_patterns: Articulate, calm, and multilingual, able to pick up new dialects and sound like a native within hours.
mannerisms: Carries books and scrolls with care, listens intently, and speaks with measured precision.
motivations: To provide an exceptional education to the youth of Waterdeep and honor the academic mission of Murkledorn's Academy.
knowledge: Mastery of numerous languages, history, writing systems, and local academic lore.
gm_notes: Romero Multari serves as an educated and reliable resident of Trollskull Alley. He can be used to translate foreign texts, decode secret languages, or act as an academic contact for the party.
